propositions: Open or in_progress bugs with caused_by edges into the epic subtree must deterministically block epic close before any LLM verification.

Candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the epic subtree (any relation, any depth), capped at 32 evaluated with overflow tracking.

Haiku relevance screen must classify candidates as A (describes defect in epic deliverable), B (pre-existing/adjacent), or C (unrelated) with one-line citation, using model-class config and prompt cache, then forward up to 8 A-verdicts as compact evidence to the verifier.

Completion verifier must adjudicate only via store-grounded disposition signals: supersedes/duplicates links or reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose (bare 'out of scope' insufficient), blocking only undispositioned defect-in-deliverable candidates.
Screen output must use epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator (defaulting unrecognized output to C), and screen failure degrades open (logs reason) without blocking the close.

Regression fixtures (30a2, 5b09, 30d3, e6a0, c8ed, 5e94, 22f5) must validate the DET floor, filter timing anchor, screen staging, and verifier disposition rule end-to-end with live calibration proving the real haiku path and adjudication.
